The demon sorcerer makes two abyssal bolt attacks.
Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) fire damage.
One creature the demon sorcerer can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 13 necrotic damage. The demon sorcerer regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

biography.value:
Everything in the other nine worlds was working for him, whether it knew it or not. He is the last thing in the book and he is sitting down.

How it fights. Guards, then three strikes a turn, and he does not stand up until the second half of the fight.

The Abyss · The Demon Throne · written for a level 20 party. From the free card game at AxesAndAces.com.

description.value: Magical darkness doesn't impede the the demon king's darkvision.
The the demon king has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
If the the demon king fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
The the demon king's weapon attacks are magical.
A creature that touches the the demon king or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 18 fire damage.
The the demon king deals double damage to objects and structures.
Blades turn on it. It has resistance to slashing damage.
The the demon king makes two ruinous claws attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) slashing damage.

The the demon king throws everything into one strike. Each creature within 45 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 93 (17d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The the demon king sets itself and gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the start of its next turn. While hardened, its speed is 0.
